positions.title: Software Engineer (Data Engineering)
positions.description:
Architected email processing internal tools microservice handling automated parsing of IL Secretary of State attachments from dual mailboxes, implementing fuzzy name matching algorithms for accurate student database lookups and file uploads
Led end-to-end feature delivery for high-impact initiatives including FedEx API Migration and TypeScript conversion across multiple services. Optimized MongoDB queries and built comprehensive testing frameworks, increasing code coverage from 27% to 85%+.
Developed automated reporting systems for State Government compliance and created Puppeteer automation scripts that eliminate 4+ hours of manual work daily. Enhanced FedEx API integration, reducing support tickets by 40%.
Mentored junior developers and collaborated with cross-functional teams to achieve 95% first-pass feature delivery success rate. Active contributor to technical documentation and knowledge sharing initiatives.
Key Technologies: Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, React, Vue.js, AWS, Puppeteer, Unit Testing

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and enhanced legacy enterprise platform using Coldfusion, Lucee, ReactJS, and SQL. Progressed from production bug fixes to leading complex "boulder" projects that had been in backlog for extended periods.
Built automated data synchronization system using serverless Lambda functions and Node.js to process CSV participation lists from National Student Clearinghouse, ensuring real-time database accuracy through automated comparison and updates.
Delivered rapid application development solutions while managing technical challenges across multiple concurrent projects with weekly release cycles.
Key Technologies: Coldfusion/Lucee, ReactJS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda, SQL

positions.title: Implementation Engineer
positions.description:
Architected 3-5 new API integrations weekly using Java and Ruby on Rails, connecting previously unsupported ERP systems to Cloudsnap platform. Implemented diverse authentication protocols including OAuth 2.0, OAuth 1.0, Basic Auth, and API keys.
Researched complex API documentation and provided technical guidance to enterprise clients on web service configuration and credential management for secure data access.
Successfully integrated APIs for major enterprise applications including Concur, Mavenlink, HubSpot, BigQuery, NetSuite, Deltek Ajera, Chargify, Yardi, and UltiPro.
Key Technologies: Java, Ruby on Rails, RESTful/SOAP APIs, OAuth 2.0, Enterprise Integrations

projects.title: GetDraftednNow
projects.description:
GetDraftedNow — Solo Production Project | www.getdraftednow.com | 2026 - Present
Real-time, async multiperson drafting platform designed, built, and operated end to end as the sole engineer. Live in production.
● Built and shipped the full stack solo: Node.js, TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis/BullMQ, Socket.io, Vue, and Stripe, deployed on Railway.
● Guaranteed exactly-once pick selection under concurrent load using SERIALIZABLE Postgres transactions with row-level locks, so two users acting on the same slot can never double-pick.
● Built a server-authoritative timer system on BullMQ and Redis that keeps draft clocks accurate through client disconnects and reconnects instead of trusting the browser.
● Designed an optimistic UI backed by monotonic snapshot versioning, with self-healing reconciliation that detects and repairs race conditions rather than dropping or corrupting state.
● Integrated Stripe billing with a daily reconciliation job to catch and correct
